comment: The word lists Sinhala input ranks and completes with, in this order (earlier = more frequent). scripts/wordlist.mjs checks each file's sha256 and merges them; the plugin build writes the result to scripts/sinhala-words.js.

lists.name: LIRNEasia Sinhala stopwords (Corpus-Sinhala-Redux)
lists.attribution: Wijeratne, Y., de Silva, N. (2020). Sinhala Language Corpora and Stopwords from a Decade of Sri Lankan Facebook. LIRNEasia.
lists.changes: none; the merge adds the zero-width joiner the source leaves out of rakaransaya and yansaya (්ර, ්ය)
lists.order: frequency in the corpus, most frequent first

lists.name: Sinhala Words List (slwdc)
lists.licence: GPL-3.0-only (slwdc-LICENSE.txt); combined with AGPL-3.0 code under GPL-3.0 section 13
lists.changes: byte-order mark removed; the 4 entries longer than 20 characters dropped
lists.order: alphabetical (no frequencies): ranked after the lists above, shorter words first
